output.headline: On 2026-11-02, 1 campaign ran and delivered 2 leads at $55.45 each from $110.90 in spend.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign active, generating 6,015 impressions, 70 clicks, and a click rate of 1.2%.
Both leads came from Regional Class A — Joliet at a cost per lead of $55.45.
Month-to-date spend on Meta for 2026-11 sits at $198.00 with 29 days left in the month.
The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) is the strongest mature group: contact rate 90.0%, qualified rate 50.0%, hired rate 12.5%.
The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) shows a contact rate of 86.8%, a qualified rate of 44.7%, and a hired rate of 10.5%.
